subject: Aligning co-sell routing and private-offer term cadence for MidCap deal
messages:
From: Rohan Mehta <rohan_mehta@redwoodinference.com>
To: Christine Liu <cliu@midcaptech.com>
Cc: Ethan Park <ethan_park@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 7 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Aligning co-sell routing and private-offer term cadence for MidCap deal

Christine —

Thanks again for the time today. Per our conversation, I wanted to put the two private-offer structuring options in writing so we can confirm buyer approvals and the routing expectations with your procurement team:

1) Standard 12-month private offer (baseline):
   - List-based discount: 15% off list
   - Payment: Net 30 via AWS Marketplace
   - Buyer approval path: single approver for orders < $200k; procurement signature required above that

2) Extended-term 18-month private offer (preferred co-sell cadence for MidCap):
   - Uplift vs baseline: +10% (effective discount ~13.5% over 18 months)
   - Payment: Net 45 allowed by exception; SLA-backed refund clauses standard
   - Buyer approval path: procurement sign-off + executive contract signature for ACV > $500k

Questions for you / next steps:
- Can your procurement confirm whether they require additional buyer approvals inside AWS Marketplace (e.g., legal review for private offers > $250k)?
- If procurement needs a longer routing lane, we can prepare an AWS Marketplace private-offer checklist and route via our co-sell specialist — would you like us to include that?

Attached is a first-pass pricing matrix and a short checklist I think will be helpful. Ethan is cc'd and will provide any technical gating items we should include in the private-offer metadata.

If this looks right, I can loop in Vanessa to coordinate the AWS Marketplace configuration and DocuSign next steps.

Thanks,
Rohan
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rohan_mehta@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0192

Attachments:
- RDW-MidCap-pricing-matrix.xlsx (spreadsheet)
- AWS-PO-checklist.pdf (doc)
From: Christine Liu <cliu@midcaptech.com>
To: Rohan Mehta <rohan_mehta@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procure@midcaptech.com>, Amir Shah <amir.shah@midcaptech.com>
Date: Tue, 7 Sep 2026 11:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Aligning co-sell routing and private-offer term cadence for MidCap deal

Rohan —

Appreciate the summary. A few clarifying items from Procurement: 

- For private offers submitted via AWS Marketplace, procurement needs the expected contract term and payment cadence included in the offer metadata (we cannot accept ambiguous Net terms). Net 45 is possible but requires a PO issuance timeline to be included.
- Any private offer above $250k needs an internal legal review. That review is triggered automatically when we see an offer > $250k in the marketplace payload; so please ensure you flag that.
- We typically approve 18-month terms for strategic vendors but require an exec sponsor approval if ACV > $400k. Who would sign as exec sponsor on Redwood's side?

Also, can your team confirm how credits/refunds are handled for early termination in the 18-month structure? Procurement needs a simple clause for our contract team.

Cc'ing Amir (Finance) to confirm budget lanes — he'll reply separately about the $ threshold.

Thanks,
Christine Liu
Head of Procurement | MidCap Tech
cliu@midcaptech.com
From: Rohan Mehta <rohan_mehta@redwoodinference.com>
To: Christine Liu <cliu@midcaptech.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procure@midcaptech.com>, Ethan Park <ethan_park@redwoodinference.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 8 Sep 2026 08:35:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Aligning co-sell routing and private-offer term cadence for MidCap deal

Christine —

Thanks — answered inline below and adding Vanessa to coordinate Marketplace/DocuSign and to act as exec sponsor contact for approvals: vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com.

- Net terms: We can populate Net 45 on the private-offer payload. We'll include a PO issuance timeline (30 days) as part of order notes so your AP team has the path.
- Legal review trigger: Noted. We will add metadata flag "requires_internal_legal=true" for offers >= $250k.
- Exec sponsor: Vanessa is our default co-sell exec sponsor for MidCap (she can sign the acceptance on Redwood's behalf for ACV <= $750k). If your legal team needs formal signing authority proof, Vanessa will share her approver matrix.
- Early termination: For the 18-month option we propose a pro-rata credit on unused months minus a 10% administrative fee; I'll attach a short clause for your legal team.

Ethan — quick note on the technical gating items we discussed: please confirm whether the Marketplace listing should include the integrated SSO addendum and whether we need to attach the SOC2 evidence bundle as a link in the offer metadata.

I'll prepare the AWS PO checklist (attached) and a DocuSign proposal for your review once Procurement confirms the budget threshold.

Rohan

On Tue, Sep 7, 2026 at 09:12 AM Rohan Mehta <rohan_mehta@redwoodinference.com> wrote:
> Christine —
> 
> Thanks again for the time today. Per our conversation...
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
To: Christine Liu <cliu@midcaptech.com>, Rohan Mehta <rohan_mehta@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procure@midcaptech.com>, Ethan Park <ethan_park@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 10 Sep 2026 15:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Aligning co-sell routing and private-offer term cadence for MidCap deal

Thanks everyone — looping AWS co-sell specialist if we need assisted routing, but we can do the private-offer path directly and still qualify for co-sell credit with the following plan:

1) Offer structuring (what we'll submit to AWS Marketplace):
   - SKU: RDW-ENTERPRISE-MIDCAP-18M
   - Term: 18 months (preferred) with early-termination pro-rata credit less 10% admin fee
   - Pricing: baseline 12-month equivalent price with +10% uplift for 18-month term (documented in the attached pricing matrix)
   - Metadata flags: requires_internal_legal=true; co_sell_opportunity=true; co_sell_specialist=unassigned

2) Buyer approval routing (what MidCap will see in marketplace UI):
   - Orders < $200k: auto-approve (single approver)
   - $200k–$400k: procurement approval required
   - $400k–$750k: procurement + exec sponsor (MidCap)
   - > $750k: procurement + exec sponsor + Redwood VP sign-off (Vanessa will surface to our VP for approval)

3) Next steps / docs:
   - Rohan will send DocuSign for the chosen term (12m or 18m).
   - We will flag the offer payload for legal review when the HubSpot deal amount >= $250k.
   - Attachments: DocuSign-Proposal-4821.pdf, RDW-MidCap-pricing-matrix.xlsx, AWS-PO-checklist.pdf

Christine — if that routing matrix aligns with your procurement bands, please confirm and we'll issue the DocuSign draft. If Amir wants to approve via email we can accept that as an interim sign-off and then formalize the PO in Marketplace after signature.

Vanessa Ortiz
Director, Partnerships | Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com
+1 (212) 555-0104

---
Procurement Team <procure@midcaptech.com>
Reply: Confirmed interim approval for $300k lane; legal will kick once HubSpot shows >= $250k.
